item.title: Following big Democratic wins, these swing voters are looking for results
item.description: For the swing voters NPR is regularly checking in with as part of its Swing Shift series, the election results brought mixed emotions, as does the pending Democratic control of Congress.

item.title: House effectively ends Hegseth impeachment. And, 3 men accused of plotting U.K. attacks
item.description: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth has been spared from the House's impeachment effort, at least for now. And, federal prosecutors arrested three men accused of being Iran-backed operatives.

item.description: Descendants of President John F. Kennedy are asking a judge to block President Trump's monumental arch near Arlington National Cemetery.

item.title: Ex-CIA officer on UK investigations into alleged Iran, Russia threats
item.description: NPR's Michel Martin speaks with former CIA senior executive clandestine service officer Daniel Hoffman about investigations in Britain into alleged threats linked to Iran and Russia.

item.title: Iran-backed trio accused of plotting attacks on U.K. base hosting U.S. jets
item.description: Iran-backed operatives have been charged over nearly 20 attacks, including a plot on a U.K. base housing U.S. troops. Separately, a U.S. soldier is held in the U.K. on Russia spying claims.

item.title: Close Trump ally to lead House Republicans next year
item.description: House Republicans will have a new leader at the start of the new Congress in January: Ohio's Jim Jordan, a co-founder of the ultra-conservative Freedom Caucus and a close ally of President Trump.
item.content:encoded: House Republicans will have a new leader at the start of the new Congress in January: Ohio's Jim Jordan, a co-founder of the ultra-conservative Freedom Caucus and a close ally of President Trump.

item.title: House votes to end the impeachment effort against Pete Hegseth
item.description: The House was on course for a floor vote Wednesday on whether to impeach Pete Hegseth. That is until House Republicans used a procedural vote to effectively end the impeachment effort.
